own_lines: I was fostered by a travelling puppet troupe.
I drove mules over the high roads. You learn which stretches are safe and which only look it.
A widow taught me my letters and asked only that I teach someone else. I have kept to that bargain.
Trouble does its planning in the quiet hours. So I keep an eye on the quiet.
I have one old friend, and the letters come twice a year. They are the best part of my winter.
I am saving to buy back the family stall. Every coin has a name on it.
Boats tied up after the evening bell lose their berth to whoever wants it.
The oldest saying around the Salt Quay is that every road ends at somebody's supper.
Most of what is said about the giant weasel is probably exaggerated, but not all of it.
I have been watching the road for days, and I trust very few of the faces on it.
Nothing crosses from the Salt Quay to the Tidewatch Lamp Room without somebody noticing, so move quietly.
I am a watch sergeant at the Tidewatch Lamp Room.
Liora sent word that you would come for the seed sack.
What matters is that you came.
You have friends here now, whether you wanted them or not.

exchanges.hero_words: Perrin? Liora sent us. What have you got for us?
exchanges.reply: Liora sent word you would come for the seed sack. Do not blame Liora. She only passed along the message.

exchanges.hero_words: Who is making trouble out here?
exchanges.reply: I can’t name anyone making trouble. Most of what’s said about the giant weasel is exaggerated, though not all of it, and trouble on the road is likeliest when the light is worst. I’ve watched the road for days, and I trust very few faces on it.

answer_from: The road toward the Tidewatch Lamp Room is quietest an hour before dawn, and if trouble comes it will come when the light is worst.

exchanges.hero_words: What would you do in our place?
exchanges.reply: I would take the road toward the Tidewatch Lamp Room an hour before dawn. It is quietest then. If trouble comes, it will come when the light is worst, so keep watch.

exchanges.hero_words: Where do we go from here?
